reason: I've already been stung by a web designer who took my money and sat on my site. A company in Kuwait with no UK office, no reviews and no past clients, wanting 50% upfront by PayPal? Same risk again, and this time they're even further away.
objection: There's nobody to show me it works. If they go quiet after I pay half, I can't walk into an office, and I've got nothing to chase them with.
would_change_my_mind: A few real Manchester businesses I can actually ring or visit who say they delivered on time, plus a small deposit with most of the money paid only once the site is live.
